name: Keystone Trap
disable: DC 24 Thievery check (trained) to find and press hidden knobs in a specific order (three successes are required to disable the trap, which also opens it); DC 24 Crafting check (expert) to sabotage the vault's mechanisms, reducing its actions by 1 (when the trap's actions are reduced to 0, it is disabled)
routine: The keystone uses its 3 actions to Electrify, Spin, and then Launch Darts. When the trap loses an action, roll randomly to determine which action it loses.

items.name: Exposed Vault
items.text:
Trigger The vault is exposed

---

Effect The vault makes a poison dart spray Strike at a random creature within 30 feet. The trap then rolls initiative.

items.name: Electrify
items.text: The metal vault crackles with electricity. In air, this would damage only creatures touching it; in water, the trap deals 2d8 electricity damage to all creatures in a 10-foot emanation (DC 25 basic Fortitude save).

items.name: Launch Darts
items.text: The vault fires a stream of poisoned darts. The trap attacks all creatures in a 30-foot line with its poison dart spray Strike; roll 1d8 to determine the line's direction. These Strikes don't have a multiple attack penalty.

items.name: Spin
items.text: The vault spins quickly for 1 round. While it Spins, checks to disable the trap have a -2 circumstance penalty, and it Launches Darts at all creatures within 30 feet of it, rather than in a line.

text: A 5-foot-square metal vault covered with knobs lies concealed within a stone block. A lever on the stone block slides the vault into view. When the vault is exposed-whether it's slid out or whether the stone is smashed open-the trap activates.
